focus: Reconcile Bitnomial's actual XRP collateral capability with DCO/FCM regulatory layers; map Ripple Prime/Hidden Road clearing membership; update Coinbase and Circle payment-rail strategy; compare current XRP derivatives and ETF data with explicit universe/timestamp limitations; reconfirm Japanese SBIC identity.

findings.claim: Bitnomial announced on November 3, 2025 that XRP and RLUSD margin deposits were available to institutional clients trading leveraged perpetuals, futures and options, subject to applicable approvals.
Bitnomial's current clearinghouse page lists XRP collateral at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit; XRP product maintenance margin is separately 17%.

CFTC staff FAQ distinguishes DCO crypto initial-margin acceptance and monthly haircut review from FCM Letter 26-05 notice, initial three-month stablecoin/BTC/ETH restriction, incident reporting and weekly reports. After the initial period, other qualifying crypto assets may be accepted subject to continuing conditions. The FAQ is nonbinding staff guidance.

Ripple identifies Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC as a registered FCM and broker-dealer; Bitnomial lists that exact entity as a clearing member; Ripple says Hidden Road is now Ripple Prime. This is a direct legal-entity clearing-network relationship, but not evidence of XRP deposits by that FCM.
No public evidence in this run establishes Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC's Letter 26-05 WinJammer notice, reliance commencement date, XRP customer balances or utilization.

Coinbase Q3 reported 10.7% trading-volume share, $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products, prediction markets above $200M annualized run-rate, subscription/services at 49% of net revenue, and adjusted net income $78M versus $719M GAAP net income.
Circle and ACI announced a Colombia USDC settlement pilot through ACI Connetic and Bre-B; the announcement does not identify XRPL/XRP or disclose production volumes.

TradRadar's 02:15 UTC snapshot shows XRP $1.216, -6.15% in 24 hours, OI $1.80B (-7.74%), aggregate funding -0.0028%/8h, at least $31.86M liquidations with $30.65M long, and 79.6% long-account share. This is consistent with deleveraging but not a directional forecast.

CryptoKeyhole reports +4.338M XRP on October 28 across four funds and 1.075B XRP held; XRP Insights reports +174.1K provisional across six spot funds plus BITW, with 1.19B held and -2.96M over October 26-28. Different universes and settlement rules prevent combining these series.
